description: This file contains the implementation of the ZoneDao interface, providing database access methods for Zone entities. It includes methods for listing zones filtered by language and country, utilizing QueryDSL for building JPA queries.

classes.name: ZoneDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ZoneDao interface, extending generic DAO and providing methods to query Zone entities based on language and country.

methods.name: listByLanguageAndCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones filtered by specified country and language.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of zones filtered by specified language.
